subject: P2 Spec: prefers-reduced-motion guard sweep -- 10 unguarded transitions in shared/styles.css
body:
## Problem
Animation audit (da-14) found 10 CSS transitions in shared/styles.css that lack prefers-reduced-motion guards. Only .timer-critical, .skip-link, and .grade-a-flash are guarded. All interactive element transitions are unguarded.

## WCAG Impact
WCAG 2.3.3 (AAA) and 2.3.3 overlap with user preference: exposing animation to users who have enabled prefers-reduced-motion (often epilepsy, vestibular disorders, some ADHD users). This is a MCM accessibility gap.

## Required Fix
Add a single consolidated @media block at the end of shared/styles.css:

```css
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  /* Sweep: disable all transitions not already guarded */
  .submit-btn,
  .nav-btn,
  .hint-btn,
  .question-card,
  .radio-option,
  .input-group input,
  .hint-content,
  .hints-container {
    transition: none;
  }
}
```

Do NOT touch:
- .timer-critical animation (already guarded)
- .skip-link transition (already guarded)
- .grade-a-flash animation (already guarded)
- .session-restore-toast animation (new, not yet in styles.css -- include it when you implement)
- .correct-pulse animation (exam.html -- already has guard)

## Acceptance Criteria
1. Single @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block at end of shared/styles.css
2. All 10 unguarded transitions in the block
3. Existing guards (timer-critical, skip-link, grade-a-flash) left unchanged
4. No visual change in normal operation
5. Transitions disabled for users with prefers-reduced-motion set

## What NOT to change
- Any transition values
- Any animation keyframes
- The list of guarded animations (they're already correct)
- exam.html (only shared/styles.css needs the sweep)

## Scope
- shared/styles.css: 1 @media block addition at end of file

## Priority: P2
Users with vestibular disorders or epilepsy are affected by unguarded animation. This is not cosmetic.

## Related
- da-14: Animation audit (finding: 10 unguarded transitions)
- WCAG 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA)
